# What's Changed

The 4.0.1 release had missing module files on npm; this release fixes it.

## Release

* Build both script & module files on release, fix the map file by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/613

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/compare/4.0.1...4.0.2

# What's Changed

This is the first Migrate release meant for jQuery 4.0.0. :tada:

## Core

* Prepare for Migrate 4.0.0 by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/555
* Provide a package.json exports setup inspired by jQuery Core by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/566
* Make migrateWarnProp not return the prop for disabled patches by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/571
* Remove compatibility patches needed when upgrading TO jQuery 1.x/2.x by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/555, issue https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/issues/549
* Differentiate between compatibility patches and pure warnings by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/555, issue https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/issues/472
* Patch & warn against jQuery.now & jQuery.camelCase by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/599

## Data

* Patch & warn about props from Object.prototype in data objects by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/561
* Patch `$._data` as well by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/569

## Deferred

* Don't warn on setting getStackHook to the getErrorHook value by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/577

## Event

* Patch jQuery.event.global by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/574
* Patch jQuery.event.special's prototype by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/573

## Docs

* Improve the solution for `boolean-attributes` by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/588
* Fix an incorrect warning message & other issues in warnings.md by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/593
* Fix typos, comments, etc. by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/607

## Manipulation

* Remove jQuery.UNSAFE_restoreLegacyHtmlPrefilter by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/555, issue https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/issues/520

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/compare/3.6.0...4.0.1

# What's Changed

This release prepares jQuery 3.x apps better for a future migration to jQuery 4.x. It also drops support for jQuery 4.x - once you do update to jQuery 4.x, you should load jQuery Migrate 4.x.

## Core

* Fill in & warn against $.fn.{push,sort,splice} by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/529
* Fill in & warn against jQuery.proxy by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/530
* Fix the selector module, make CI green by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/552
* Remove support for jQuery 4.x by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/554
* Patch push, sort & splice in jQuery >=3.7.0 by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/568
* Warn against jQuery.now & jQuery.camelCase by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/600

## Ajax

* Fill in & warn against automatic JSON-to-JSONP promotion by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/531

## Attributes

* Warn & restore boolean attribute & false setter treatment from 3.x by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/540

## Data

* Patch camelCase behavior of $.fn.data, warn about Object.prototype by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/559
* Patch `$._data` & `$._removeData` as well, add more tests by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/570

## Deferred

* Fill in & warn `jQuery.Deferred.getStackHook` by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/528
* Don't warn on setting getStackHook to the getErrorHook value by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/578

## Event

* Patch jQuery.event.special's prototype by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/572

## Selector

* Patch & warn against legacy selector pseudos by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/546

## Others

* Docs: Add an entry for `legacy-self-closed-tags` in `warnings.md` by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/526
* Docs: Tweak README.md & warnings.md - update removal info by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/596
* Docs: Indicate which deprecated APIs are removed in 4.0; tweak a comment by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/606
* Tests: Migrate test runner to jquery-test-runner by @timmywil in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/560
* Build: Test more browsers and jquery versions in pull requests by @mgol in https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/pull/551

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/compare/3.5.2...3.6.0

name: 4.0.0-beta.2
body:
The only change compared to [`4.0.0-beta.1`](https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/releases/tag/4.0.0-beta.1) is fixing `peerDependencies` so that jQuery Migrate `4.0.0-beta.2` can be installed alongside jQuery `4.0.0-beta.2` or newer. `4.0.0-beta.1` required a stable jQuery `4.0.0` or newer which doesn't exist yet.

Read the [`4.0.0-beta.1`](https://github.com/jquery/jquery-migrate/releases/tag/4.0.0-beta.1) release notes for more details.

name: 4.0.0-beta.1
body:
The first jQuery Migrate pre-release compatible with jQuery 4.0.0-rc.1.

Major changes:
* Core: Remove support for jQuery 3.x (gh-472, gh-555)

* Core: Remove patches for breaking changes in jQuery 3.0.0 or older (gh-472, gh-555)

   The `self-closed-tags` patch remains, despite being a breaking change in jQuery
   3.5.0, not 4.0.0. There are a few reasons for that:
   1. It's an exception that a breaking change arrived in a non-major version bump.
      Some people may be upgrading from jQuery 3.4.0 or older and it's good to
      make it work for them.
   2. The patch is disabled by default, so the concern of people on newer jQuery
      3.x upgrading to jQuery 4.x with Migrate 4.x getting patches restoring
      behavior from an version older than the pre-upgrade one does not exist.
   3. This was a pretty big break, it may help people update if we still support
      it.

* Core: Don't reimplement deprecated but not removed APIs (gh-472, gh-555)

   This will save space and avoid potential divergence from Core.

   Also, simplify the `deferred.pipe` patch.

* Core: Use `console.info` for deprecations without removals (gh-472, gh-555)

   Also:
   1. Group `warnings.md` by this type.
   2. Rename `jQuery.migrateWarnings` to `jQuery.migrateMessages`.
   3. Rename `jQuery.migrateDeduplicateWarnings` to
      `jQuery.migrateDeduplicateMessages`.
   4. Adding "info" versions of some internal APIs.

* Core: Provide a package.json exports setup inspired by jQuery Core (gh-524, gh-566)
   
   The Migrate setup is simpler than Core as it doesn't have the slim or factory
   versions, but the core ideas are similar.
   
* Core: Don't warn just on access of `jQuery.fn.push`, etc., but when it's called (gh-571)
   
* Data: Patch & warn about props from Object.prototype in data objects (gh-561, gh-559)
   
* Data: Patch `$._data` as well (gh-569, gh-570)
   
* Event: Patch jQuery.event.global (gh-574)
   
* Event: Patch jQuery.event.special's prototype (gh-573, gh-542)
   
   Allow to use common `Object.prototype` properties on `jQuery.event.special` but
   warn as well.

This release introduces only one change:
* Make Migrate properly recognized as a CommonJS module in Node.js (#523, #525)

Note: you may also find jQuery Migrate 3.5.1 on npm. Do not use it, it's a result of a bad release.

Changes:
* Manipulation: Deprecate jQuery.UNSAFE_restoreLegacyHtmlPrefilter (#518)
* Attributes: Fix compatibility with jQuery 4.x (#496, #495)
* Docs: Mark `jQuery.fn.load( [ eventData ], handler )` as removed (#482)
* Replace karma and testswarm with jQuery test runner (#503 + followups)
